ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels dominate approximately 90% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels concentrated in a central vertical region around the notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-contrast mapping consists of a light-grey vertical zone originating at the median notch and extending basally. The remainder of the fluke area is a uniform dark-grey to black field with minor localized pixel fluctuations.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 40 degrees, penetrating significantly toward the fluke center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge; right lobe exhibits larger amplitude peaks (approx. 5-10 pixels) on the inner margin, while the left lobe shows finer, more frequent serrations toward the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes follow a distinct concave trajectory along the trailing edge, sweeping outward and upward into sharp, acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A prominent, high-density cluster of high-intensity circular pixel blobs (barnacle colonization) is localized at the extreme tip of the right fluke lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One long, distinct diagonal light-grey linear disruption on the upper-mid region of the left lobe; multiple smaller, faint horizontal and semi-circular linear markings are visible on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive calcified accumulation on the right distal tip; significant diagonal linear scar on the left lobe quadrant; several small white focal spots on the lower right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The central white pigmentation patch features a ragged, non-linear boundary where it interfaces with the darker fluke pigmentation.
